node.title: Re: Initialisation of variables
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
I would consider a ton of lexical variables code smell, especially if there's too many for you to count, and you are probably better off with a data structure like a hash or array. (see also [doc://perldsc])

But to avoid the repetition in the example you showed you can write: my ($x,$y,$z) = (42) x 3; ([doc://perlop#Multiplicative-Operators|repetition operator])
